text:
Rest up, you've covered a lot of ground.

One correction before you save the notes: I wrote "COBIT 2019 (and its successor, COBIT 2019 with updates)," which makes no sense. COBIT 2019 is the current version, and it has no separate successor. The rest of the COBIT description stands.

If you come back to this, the most useful next step is a gap analysis of your current ITIL processes against the Annex A controls. For now, get some rest.
